svg.title: NULL0 HEX99 starchart
svg.desc: Nine rows of eleven hexagons. Eighteen cells have one pentagram and eighty-one have two, totaling 180. Two XOR slots per pentagram make 360. This is a symbolic display.

g.text: 18 single-star + 81 double-star cells = 180; 2 XOR slots per star.
Violet points: symbolic opposing-polarity interfaces, not measured forces.
